Usar la forma formal 'If I were...' (en lugar de 'was') para dar consejos hipotéticos ('If I were you, I would...').
Debatir escenarios imaginarios sobre liderazgo global, inventos futuristas y superpoderes.

readingContext.title: Reading Studio: The Student Council Presidential Debate / El Debate Estudiantil

sampleDialogue.speaker: Felipe
sampleDialogue.text: If I were elected student council president, I would create an innovative esports and digital arts lounge for everyone!
sampleDialogue.es: ¡Si fuera elegido personero estudiantil, crearía una sala innovadora de esports y artes digitales para todos!

sampleDialogue.speaker: Mariana
sampleDialogue.text: That sounds thrilling! And what would you do if our budget were limited?
sampleDialogue.es: ¡Eso suena emocionante! ¿Y qué harías si nuestro presupuesto fuera limitado?

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Teen Environmental Manifesto / El Manifiesto Ecológico
listening.transcription: If I were the Minister of the Environment, I would immediately ban single-use plastics and plant one million native trees in Colombia.
listening.audioTeacherText: If I were the Minister of the Environment, I would immediately ban single-use plastics and plant one million native trees in Colombia.
listening.question: What two actions would the speaker take if she were Minister of the Environment?
options: Ban single-use plastics and plant one million native trees.
Cut down all forests and pollute rivers.
Ban all trees and paint roads purple.
listening.correctAnswerText: Ban single-use plastics and plant one million native trees.

classes.classTitle: Class 5: Agreeing & Disagreeing Respectfully / Acuerdos y Desacuerdos Respetuosos en Debates
classes.classObjective: Expresar acuerdos totales, parciales y desacuerdos corteses en debates juveniles usando conectores diplomáticos (however, although, on the other hand).
goals: Expresar acuerdos parciales con 'I see your point, but...' y 'I agree to some extent'.
Plantear desacuerdos diplomáticos con 'I respectfully disagree because...' y 'On the other hand'.
Debatir temas de tecnología, colegio y vida juvenil defendiendo tu postura con argumentos sólidos.

readingContext.title: Reading Studio: The High School AI Debate Tournament / El Torneo de Debate

sampleDialogue.speaker: Santiago
sampleDialogue.text: In my opinion, AI assistants should be fully integrated into classrooms because they personalize learning for every student.
sampleDialogue.es: En mi opinión, los asistentes de IA deberían integrarse plenamente en las aulas porque personalizan el aprendizaje para cada estudiante.

sampleDialogue.speaker: Valeria
sampleDialogue.text: I see your point about personalization, Santiago, but we must also ensure students develop their own critical thinking skills.

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Debate Moderator Closing Speech / Veredicto del Moderador
listening.transcription: Both teams presented compelling arguments. While team A highlighted innovation, team B rightly emphasized human ethics and student discipline.
listening.audioTeacherText: Both teams presented compelling arguments. While team A highlighted innovation, team B rightly emphasized human ethics and student discipline.
listening.question: What did the moderator conclude about both teams?
options: Both presented compelling arguments balancing innovation with ethics and discipline.
Both teams failed and started screaming.
Neither team knew what they were talking about.
listening.correctAnswerText: Both presented compelling arguments balancing innovation with ethics and discipline.

classes.classTitle: Class 6: Podcast & Media Hosting Basics / Fundamentos de Podcasting y Locución en Inglés
classes.classObjective: Conducir un segmento de podcast o programa juvenil en inglés de 60 segundos con intro carismática, entrevista y despedida con 'Stay tuned!'.

sampleDialogue.text: Thank you for having me Valentina! It is super exciting to be here on the show.

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Podcast Show Opening Hook / Gancho de Apertura
listening.transcription: Welcome to Global Teen Spotlight! Today we are exploring youth sustainability projects. If you enjoy this episode, hit the subscribe button and stay tuned for part two!
listening.audioTeacherText: Welcome to Global Teen Spotlight! Today we are exploring youth sustainability projects. If you enjoy this episode, hit the subscribe button and stay tuned for part two!
listening.question: What is the host's call to action at the end of the intro?

Turn off your phone and go to sleep.
Delete the podcast app immediately.
listening.correctAnswerText: Hit the subscribe button and stay tuned for part two.

classes.classObjective: Distinguir acciones finalizadas de procesos continuos en desarrollo usando Have/Has been + Verbo-ING y marcadores de duración (for 3 hours, since 2022).

levelTitle: Level 9 - Advanced Elite (Global Tech Founders & Diplomacy) / Nivel 9 - Avanzado Élite

classes.classTitle: Class 1: Future Milestones & Tech Forecasting / Hitos del Futuro y Pronósticos Tecnológicos
classes.classObjective: Diferenciar con precisión el Future Continuous (will be deploying) y el Future Perfect (will have colonized) usando preposiciones temporales avanzadas (by 2035, by the time, in ten years' time) en discursos de futurología y tecnología de frontera.
goals: Dominar el Future Continuous: 'Will be + [Verbo-ING]' para describir actividades que estarán ocurriendo en el futuro.

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Tech Venture Boardroom Post-Mortem Audio / Audio de Junta Post-Mortem

classes.classTitle: Class 3: Cleft Sentences & Emphatic Rhetoric / Oraciones Hendidas y Retórica Enfática
classes.classObjective: Transformar oraciones estándar en estructuras hendidas enfáticas (It-clefts y Wh-clefts) para destacar información clave y pronunciar discursos de graduación o keynotes con impacto retórico de nivel C1.
goals: Transformar oraciones estándar en It-Clefts enfáticas: 'It was [elemento clave] that/who [acción]'.
Construir Wh-Clefts de impacto: 'What inspires me most is [propósito]' y All-Clefts: 'All we ask for is [meta]'.
Pronunciar un discurso de graduación o presentación inspiradora con modulación y énfasis retórico magistral.

readingContext.title: Reading Studio: The Harvard Youth Leadership Commencement Address / Discurso de Graduación

sampleDialogue.speaker: Valedictorian Camila
sampleDialogue.text: Fellow graduates: it was not mere luck that brought us to this stage; it was our collective grit and unyielding perseverance.
sampleDialogue.es: Compañeros graduados: no fue mera suerte lo que nos trajo a este escenario; fue nuestro coraje colectivo y perseverancia inquebrantable.

sampleDialogue.speaker: Valedictorian Camila
sampleDialogue.text: What we truly need as we step into the world is not more technology alone, but human empathy to guide our computational power.
sampleDialogue.es: Lo que verdaderamente necesitamos al salir al mundo no es más tecnología por sí sola, sino empatía humana para guiar nuestro poder computacional.

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Steve Jobs Tribute Keynote Audio / Tributo a la Oratoria Visionaria

Computers are made of plastic and pizza.
Nobody should ever use technology again.
listening.correctAnswerText: It was passion and attention to design that revolutionized computing, and what leaders leave is inspiration.

classes.classTitle: Class 4: Rhetorical Inversions & High-Impact Oratory / Inversiones Retóricas y Oratoria
classes.classObjective: Aplicar inversiones retóricas con orden de pregunta auxiliar (Rarely have I witnessed, Not only did they create) tras adverbios negativos y restrictivos en debates parlamentarios y alocuciones solemnes de nivel C1+.
goals: Dominar la inversión auxiliar con adverbios negativos: 'Rarely have I...', 'Seldom does a leader...', 'Scarcely had we arrived...'.
Construir estructuras correlativas de alto impacto: 'Not only did [Sujeto + Verbo], but [Sujeto + also + Verbo]'.
Usar 'Under no circumstances should we [acción]' para proclamar principios éticos innegociables en debates parlamentarios.

readingContext.title: Reading Studio: The World Parliamentary Youth Assembly Address / El Discurso Parlamentario

sampleDialogue.speaker: Delegate Mateo
sampleDialogue.text: Honorable members: rarely in history has a youth generation held such immense technological power to transform planetary conservation.
sampleDialogue.es: Honorables miembros: rara vez en la historia una generación juvenil ha tenido un poder tecnológico tan inmenso para transformar la conservación planetaria.

sampleDialogue.speaker: Delegate Mateo
sampleDialogue.text: Not only did our student coalition invent solar water purification filters, but we also distributed them to one hundred indigenous communities.
sampleDialogue.es: No solo nuestra coalición estudiantil inventó filtros solares de purificación de agua, sino que también los distribuimos a cien comunidades indígenas.

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Oxford Union Grand Parliamentary Debate Audio / Audio del Debate Oxford

listening.audioTeacherText: Rarely have I seen such impassioned rhetoric, and not only did the proposition dismantle every opposing claim, but they also established an inviolable moral standard for AI governance.

The speaker ate a hot dog and left the debate room.
Nobody spoke English during the Oxford final.
listening.correctAnswerText: Rarely have I seen such impassioned rhetoric, and not only did the proposition dismantle claims.

classes.classTitle: Class 5: Diplomatic Softening, Hedging & Nuanced Negotiations / Suavización Diplomática y Negociación
classes.classObjective: Emplear técnicas de suavización diplomática (hedging, verbos tentativos y pasivas impersonales) para formular posturas matizadas y negociar tratados multilaterales con máxima cortesía diplomática de nivel C1.
goals: Dominar verbos tentativos de cortesía diplomática: 'I would venture to suggest...', 'We tend to believe...'.
Usar pasivas impersonales de distanciamiento: 'It is widely acknowledged that...', 'It might be argued that...'.
Negociar una resolución de cumbre multilateral suavizando desacuerdos y forjando consensos históricos.

readingContext.title: Reading Studio: The Geneva Multilateral AI Governance Accord / El Acuerdo de Ginebra sobre IA

sampleDialogue.speaker: Ambassador Vance
sampleDialogue.text: Distinguished colleagues: while appreciating the merit of rapid innovation, I would venture to suggest that independent algorithmic auditing is essential.
sampleDialogue.es: Distinguidos colegas: si bien apreciamos el mérito de la innovación rápida, me atrevería a sugerir que la auditoría algorítmica independiente es esencial.

sampleDialogue.speaker: Delegate Sofia
sampleDialogue.text: It is widely acknowledged that ethical boundaries are necessary. However, it would appear somewhat restrictive to enforce heavy bureaucratic barriers on startup labs.
sampleDialogue.es: Es ampliamente reconocido que los límites éticos son necesarios. Sin embargo, parecería algo restrictivo imponer pesadas barreras burocráticas a los laboratorios emergentes.

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: UN Diplomatic Press Conference Audio / Conferencia de Prensa de la ONU

listening.audioTeacherText: It is widely believed that sustainable peace can be achieved, and I would venture to suggest that both parties remain remarkably amenable to a phased diplomatic accord.

He screamed that all peace treaties are totally worthless.
He told the journalists to go home and eat ice cream.
listening.correctAnswerText: It is widely believed that peace can be achieved, and I would venture to suggest both parties are amenable.

classes.classTitle: Class 6: Advanced Discursive & Argumentative Essay Architecture / Arquitectura de Ensayos Argumentativos
classes.classObjective: Estructurar ensayos académicos y discursivos con tesis de 3 niveles y conectores de transición de nivel C1/C2 para defender papers de investigación ante jurados académicos.
goals: Dominar la fórmula de Tesis de 3 Niveles: '[Concesión inicial], [Postura Central] on the grounds that [Razón A] and [Razón B]'.
Integrar conectores de transición académica de alto calibre: 'Whereas', 'In stark contrast to', 'Empirical evidence dictates'.
Redactar y defender un ensayo argumentativo riguroso ante un comité simulado de revisión por pares (Peer Review).

listening.slideTitle: Listening Lab: Harvard Academic Symposium Keynote Audio / Simposio Académico Harvard

Integrar citas académicas formales con verbos de reporte de alta precisión (corroborated, demonstrated, postulated).
Presentar y defender un póster de investigación científica ante un jurado internacional de simposio en inglés.
